So the Δ_λ chirality sign lives in the ribbon PIVOTAL structure at ζ₄, not a braid central element. OPEN (not claimed): the exact pivotal element and the magnitude |Δ_λ|=dim (Track A). Records the narrowing; does not derive Δ_λ. NOTHING wired.
